pages.title: Heralds of the Beyond
pages.text: “When the world begins to change for no reason, do not look for an explanation. Look for the one drawing near.”$(br2)Heralds are creatures whose arrival turns an ordinary place into a disaster zone. Each brings its own threat and tests your preparation.

pages.title: The order
pages.text: The cycle never changes:$(br)$(#55DDFF)Herald of Storm → Herald of Hunger → Herald of Cold → again$()$(br2)Only one Herald exists at a time. After victory or the player’s death it vanishes and the cycle moves on. If the player loses, no heart drops.$(br2)When a Herald appears, see the Diary entry on $(thing)the Pursuit$().

pages.title: General advice
pages.text: $(li)$(#2E7D4F)Spirit Apple$() in Spirit Form: Absorption and Strength.$(li)$(#2E7D4F)Fern Pearl$(): full healing and food.$(li)Do not rely on one tactic: every Herald changes the battlefield.$(li)Check your ability bar before the fight begins.
